ai_summary: Arvind Limited has announced its virtual Annual General Meeting (AGM) for September 22, 2026, and has ensured all shareholders, including those without registered emails, receive access to the FY 2025-26 Annual Report and AGM notice via a web-link, in compliance with SEBI regulations. This routine communication details e-voting timelines (September 19-21, 2026) and speaker registration for the AGM, reflecting standard corporate governance practices with no material financial impacts or red flags.
